biometric-prompt.name: Biometric Prompt
biometric-prompt.purpose: Request one biometric authentication confirmation with fallback copy without owning the complete auth, enrollment, recovery, or risk process.

anatomy.rule: Owns the visible Biometric Prompt container.
Uses symbol, icon, or motion support.

biometric-prompt.statePrecedence: disabled > error > warning > authenticating > success > focus > default
